verdict.rationale: Fern's domain setup docs explicitly list three custom domain types: subdomain (docs.mydomain.com), subpath (mydomain.com/docs) and root domain (mydomain.com). That covers both halves of the story directly. A self-hosted container option also exists for serving docs on your own infrastructure. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of custom domain and subpath hosting, and evidence of the setup mechanics (DNS records, reverse-proxy configuration for the subpath, SSL).
